title: Detection of an oxygen emission line from a high-redshift galaxy in the reionization epoch
question: What are the ISM properties (oxygen abundance, dust, neutral gas) of a z=7.2 Lyman-alpha emitter, probed via [O III] 88 um and [C II] 158 um, and do they allow ionizing photon escape?

data.angular_resolution: Band 8 natural 0.35x0.26 arcsec; tapered 0.45x0.38 arcsec; Band 6 0.80x0.60 arcsec
data.sensitivity: Band 8: 0.53 mJy/beam (20 km/s cube), 0.042 mJy/beam continuum; Band 6: 0.26 and 0.014 mJy/beam

evidence.quote: If we assume the relation derived from the entire sample of (cite: delooze14), we obtain a SFR $>100$ M$_\odot$ yr$^{-1}$

what.value: Ly-alpha redshift and NB1006 narrowband data

evidence.quote: slightly lower than the redshift determined from the Ly$\alpha$ emission line (cite: shibuya12)
For the [O iii] 88 $\mu$m line, the model presented in (cite: inoue14) is adopted.

what.value: z~7 cosmic ionizing emissivity and UV luminosity functions

external_data.citation: Bouwens et al. 2015b (cite: bouwens15b); Bouwens 2015 (cite: bouwens15); Finkelstein 2015 (cite: finkelstein15)

recipe.method: Standard CASA calibration, manual flagging, natural-weighted clean plus uv-tapered [O III] image
Gaussian fit to spectrum for redshift; imfit Gaussian fit of tapered integrated intensity image, beam-deconvolved

recipe.goal: Upper limits on [C II] and continuum; TIR
recipe.method: 3 sigma limits; TIR from modified blackbody integrated 8–1000 um
Asymmetric Gaussian fit to Lyα profile vs [O III] systemic redshift, heliocentric correction
chi^2 minimization over PEGASE2 models with nebular lines and Lyα IGM transmission, using 8 constraints including [O III] flux and IR limit
key_parameters: Z grid 0.0004–0.05; T_IGM 0.20–0.45; Rgs = 1 or 2; age lower limit 1 Myr
assumptions: Salpeter IMF 0.1–100 Msun, constant SFH, Calzetti law

recipe.goal: Ionizing photon efficiency vs reionization requirement
recipe.method: Compute fesc*xi_ion; Monte Carlo of Schechter fits to z~7 UV LFs to compare

evidence.quote: The [O iii] line is detected with a significance of $5.3\sigma$

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channels / velocity-axis and channel settings for clean
Exact clean threshold in mJy, image size and cell size
Details of the Monte Carlo Schechter integration
Grid spacing for SFR, age, E(B-V), fesc in SED fit
score_reason: Public data and decent description, but SED and imaging details sparse.
rediscovery_reason: Public ALMA data, clear imaging recipe, numeric results (flux, redshift).
